Dream 2026-11-22 linked 3 vignettes from 2 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-25 · touches · "Shared paragraphs are going to be particularly interesting to highlight" (An essay is a container for meaning that grows from exploration to argument; essays form families (2026-10-25))
- 2026-11-10 · retells · "The "shared paragraph" marker in an essay does not explain itself or allow me to know what the master paragraph is." (I cannot see where a shared paragraph came from, or what a note or reference says, without leaving the essay (2026-11-10))
- 2026-11-10 · retells · "the a paragraph master always lives in the oldest owning essay" (A shared paragraph's master always lives in the oldest owning essay; diverging is "Make a local copy" (2026-11-10))
